description: This file defines the CandidateHistory class, an entity representing the history of candidate actions within the recruitment module of the HRM system. It maps to the database table 'ohrm_job_candidate_history' and includes properties such as candidate reference, vacancy, interview details, action type, performer, timestamp, and notes. It uses Doctrine ORM annotations for ORM mapping and includes methods for accessing and modifying these properties.

classes.name: CandidateHistory
classes.description: Entity class representing a record of candidate actions or status changes, associated with candidates, vacancies, interviews, and employees, stored in 'ohrm_job_candidate_history' table.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the candidate history record.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the candidate history record.

methods.name: getCandidate
methods.description: Returns the Candidate object associated with this history record.

methods.name: setCandidate
methods.description: Associates a Candidate object with this history record.

methods.name: getVacancy
methods.description: Returns the Vacancy associated with this history record, if any.

methods.name: setVacancy
methods.description: Associates a Vacancy object with this history record.

methods.name: getCandidateVacancyName
methods.description: Returns the name of the vacancy as a string, if set.

methods.name: setCandidateVacancyName
methods.description: Sets the name of the vacancy related to this history record.

methods.name: getInterview
methods.description: Returns the Interview object linked with this history, if any.

methods.name: setInterview
methods.description: Associates an Interview with this history record.

methods.name: getAction
methods.description: Returns the integer code representing the performed action.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Sets the action code.

methods.name: getPerformedBy
methods.description: Returns the Employee who performed the action.

methods.name: setPerformedBy
methods.description: Associates an Employee as the performer of the action.

methods.name: getPerformedDate
methods.description: Returns the date and time when the action was performed.

methods.name: setPerformedDate
methods.description: Sets the timestamp for when the action was performed.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns optional notes about the history entry.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets notes related to this history record.

methods.name: getInterviewers
methods.description: Returns a deprecated list of interviewers.

methods.name: setInterviewers
methods.description: Sets a list of interviewers (deprecated).
